about: Shared demo data of all shrippen projects: Studio Weber, a small film and sound studio in Hamburg that likes to shoot at night, currently also in Graufeld, a foggy stretch of marsh at the Elbe mouth, where it films a mystery series. Under the ordinary data runs a quiet homage to Alan Wake (see 'oddities'). Everything is made up. Dates are day offsets from the anchor (Monday of the week that contains 'today', DEMO_TODAY=YYYY-MM-DD fixes 'today'). Texts are {de, en}. Edit this file, then run demo/tools/sync-demo.py. See demo/README.md.

FRITZ!OS 8.21 is offered; Selin is uploading the episode 4 cut to Northlight, so the upstream is full. The repeater in the sound studio hangs on a weak WLAN uplink and waits for an update; Theo's tablet is on the network but not in the inventory. it_docs.note: Obsidian vault with Studio Weber's IT documentation (Hansei). Dates in notes are {{day:N}} placeholders, N = day offset from the anchor. Each check of Hansei finds something: a plain-text password and token, old code names (SW-NAS01, SW-VPS, SW-PI), a missing frontmatter key, an old review date, a dead link, a full compose copy. The restore note carries the returning file of the hidden layer. Three service notes drift from their stacks: Invoice Ninja's URL and port, Nextcloud's image, and Immich runs an older image than its note names (Komodo).

Decision log for Studio Weber's IT documentation. If a note contradicts this file, this file wins.

# Names

Hosts are named after Elbe sea marks:

| Name | Former | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [[Nebelhorn]] | SW-NAS01 | NAS in the studio |
| [[Feuerschiff]] | SW-VPS | rented server at Nordhost |
| [[Boje]] | SW-PI | Raspberry Pi for DNS and uptime |

Old code names only in deprecated notes.

# Service note (minimum)

Frontmatter: `Gerät`, `URLs`, `Backup via`, `letzte Prüfung`. Body: purpose, reachability, link to the `compose.yaml` in Gitea. No full compose copies.

# Secrets

No passwords, tokens or keys in plain text. Use `siehe Vaultwarden: {entry}` or `${ENV_NAME}` instead.

# Backup

All hosts back up with Borg to [[Nebelhorn]]. Restic is retired.

content.de:
# Restore Nebelhorn

1. Borg-Repo auf der externen Platte einhängen.
2. `borg list` zeigt die Archive, das jüngste nehmen.
3. `borg extract` nach `/srv`.

Hinweis vom {{day:-4}}: `seite-7.pdf` war am Vortag gelöscht und lag im Archiv von 03:13 wieder im Nachtwache-Ordner. Ursache unklar.
content.en:
# Restore Nebelhorn

1. Mount the Borg repo on the external disk.
2. `borg list` shows the archives, take the newest.
3. `borg extract` to `/srv`.

Note from {{day:-4}}: `seite-7.pdf` was deleted the day before and was back in the Nachtwache folder in the 03:13 archive. Cause unknown.
